events.title: Cosmo Corgis is crash landing on October 28, 2026!
events.summary: Cosmo Corgis is coming to Steam on Wednesday, October 28, 2026! events.title: Space suits, distinct corgis, and a livelier demo
events.summary: Scout has some very good company The Windows demo has been updated with suited corgis, personality backpacks, and more little moments around camp. Your first three rescues each bring something different to the journey: Mechanic, in yellow: tends the rocket with a little backpack welder. Watch for the sparks and a small "Bzzzz." events.title: Corgis with freaking laser beams!
events.summary: The corgis have laser backpacks now. The recoil comes with a backflip lol. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y8X0WxxItIU Demo 1.3.0 is live! The fifth automatic gathering upgrade gives your corgi a laser backpack. It opens up, charges, blasts the resource, and sends the corgi into a backflip before packing itself away.
